name: ts-package-rooting-module-move
body:
source: the durable spine edge solution.component.ts-package-rooting —implemented-by→ ts.apg-tsfrontend.scanner.discoverPackages, authored while the TypeScript frontend lived in the flat src/tslib/scanner.ts.

Inconsistency: the tslib decomposition (plan apg-cleanup, phase-04 task-8 + tasks 342–383) splits scanner.ts into a thin orchestrator plus seven sibling .mjs modules (declarations, discovery, emit, program, resolve, state, walk). TypeScript files are namespace segments, not Module nodes — the package Module ts.apg-tsfrontend and ts.apg-tsfrontend.identity.packageIdentity are PRESERVED — but the 35 moved functions gain a file-namespace segment in their FQN, so the old flat FQNs cease to exist and the verifying scan would have shown the authored implemented-by target as drift. The only durable implemented-by edge targeting a flat ts.apg-tsfrontend.scanner.* FQN is this one.

Resolution: re-pointed the implemented-by edge here, before the verifying scan, from the flat FQN to the already-planned module-segmented FQN (pending until the decomposition lands; the planned Implementation node is kept, no real code authored):
  ts.apg-tsfrontend.scanner.discoverPackages → ts.apg-tsfrontend.discovery.discoverPackages
The component body was updated to cite the new .discovery. FQN. The preserved Module edges were left untouched: solution.component.ts-package-rooting —implemented-by→ ts.apg-tsfrontend (Module) and solution.container.ts-frontend —implemented-by→ ts.apg-tsfrontend (Module).

Prose survey: the only durable note citing the flat FQN is requirements.note.identity-defect-inventory; it is the point-in-time defect record (""observed in the branch graph / source"") that names the pre-move FQN, so it is left as historical — the same treatment the java/python/rust reconciliations gave it. requirements.note.decomposition-reframe-reconciliation cites only the preserved package Module ts.apg-tsfrontend and needs no change. requirements.constraint.module-size-scope and requirements.note.module-size-inventory cite the source PATH src/tslib/scanner.ts, not the renamed FQN; scanner.ts survives as the thin orchestrator, so both are left. The component body was updated because it is a live contract description, not a change-set record. [with coordinator]
